meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相挑刺,把计划打磨到经得起质疑再定稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手前想把方案交给多方挑刺、避免漏判错判
copy.tagline_en: Have multiple AIs critique your plan from opposing angles before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a plan stress-tested by opposing viewpoints before you commit

howto.what: 它会让 Claude 先组一支 5 人对抗团队,成员互相挑刺、攻击彼此的发现,只保留扛住质疑的结论,再交给专门的 planner 写成计划。启动时先说 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!
howto.when: 当你明确要求用 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批评的方式来规划,或这项规划需要最高强度的严谨时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我把这个迁移方案过一遍。
say.note: 会启动对抗团队交叉批评。

say.text: hyperplan:我们要不要自建搜索服务?给我一个能扛住质疑的计划。
say.note: 5 名成员先互相攻击,再出计划。

say.text: 把这个规划的薄弱点用对抗方式挑出来,别只看好的一面。
say.note: 只保留经得起攻击的结论。

howto.what_en: It turns Claude into the Lead of a 5-member adversarial team whose members attack each other's findings; only defensible insights survive and go to a dedicated planner. It starts by saying HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for a hyperplan, an adversarial or cross-critique plan, or when planning needs maximum rigor.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan on this migration plan.
Hyperplan: should we build our own search service?
say_en.note: Members attack, then a planner formalizes.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to attack this plan's weak spots.
say_en.note: Only surviving insights make it in.
